_comment: Deliberate exceptions to scripts/check_routes.py. Every entry needs a reason; an entry that stops matching anything is reported as a stale warning. 'edition' is an edition path (Laravel, Symfony, PHP Core, Cms/wordpress, Infrastructure-Creator) or '*' for every edition. Sections: unwired_hooks {path} silences an unwired-script warning; unreachable_skills {skill} silences a reachability error; references {file, target} silences one unresolved routing reference (file is edition-relative).

unwired_hooks.reason: Kept as the byte-identical mirror of the canonical .claude hook but deliberately unregistered: multi-agent is disabled in .codex/config.toml ([agents] enabled = false), so Codex has no subagent stop to observe. Documented in each edition's .codex/hooks/README.md.

unreachable_skills.reason: Description-triggered reference skill: the host selects it from its own SKILL.md description on accessibility/WCAG/a11y requests. No edition ships an agent wrapper, command or flow for it; it is consulted alongside coder-frontend and frontend-design work rather than routed to.

Description-triggered reference skill: the host selects it from its own SKILL.md description on UI/UX guideline review requests ('review my UI', 'audit design'). No edition ships an agent wrapper, command or flow for it by design.
